channel.title: ISO 20022 After Migration: Turning Payment Data into Banking Products in 2026
channel.description: ISO 20022 after migration is a data-product opportunity. Structured addresses, purpose codes, invoice details, investigation messages, and richer payment status events can become reconciliation, fraud, liquidity, compliance, and analytics products.
